standard: Visible refinement acceptable at application scale; not a numerical quality score or release approval.

front.note: Three separate drawer fronts, steel pulls and a restrained stone top remain clearly readable.

rear.note: Rear ventilation slots and the closed cabinet shell remain coherent.

detail.note: Folded pulls and consistent drawer reveals show clean construction with restrained metal texture.

underside.note: The closed dark base and small adjustable feet remain supported beneath the cabinet.

clay.note: The clay view retains distinct drawers, top overhang and recessed base without new shape defects.

front.note: Slatted tabletop sections and the central extension leaf read clearly above substantial trestles.

rear.note: Rear trestles, longitudinal support and divided tabletop retain the intended extended construction.

detail.note: Wood grain is restrained and the separate planks, apron and timber joints remain legible.

underside.note: Underside rails and diagonal trestle braces support all three tabletop sections.

clay.note: The clay view confirms connected timber framing and a distinct extension leaf; no moving mechanism is claimed.

front.note: The compact slatted table has recognizable crossed folding legs and supported top rails.

rear.note: The reverse view preserves the crossed leg geometry and restrained timber finish.

detail.note: Plank separation, small hinge hardware and beveled timber faces read cleanly.

underside.note: Underside rails meet the crossed legs; the thin frame remains coherent at catalog scale.

clay.note: The clay silhouette preserves a compact folding table with clear leg intersections and top thickness.

front.note: Glass door, visible wire shelves, vent grille and stone top distinguish the drinks refrigerator.

rear.note: Rear ventilation and the enclosed appliance body remain intact.

detail.note: The door frame, long handle, small display and individual shelf wires remain readable through the glazing.

underside.note: The base is closed and supported on small feet; the lower vent and glass door stay distinct.

clay.note: The clay view retains the recessed door and appliance proportions without changing the original cabinet envelope.

front.note: The tapered green climbing frame and small finial remain thin but readable.

rear.note: The reverse view shows a consistent arrangement of upright rods and circular supporting hoops.

detail.note: Hoops meet the tapered uprights and the restrained coated-metal surface suits the garden frame.

underside.note: The open base and unfilled frame are intentional for planting; hoop connections stay visible.

clay.note: The clay view preserves the open tapered obelisk silhouette without introducing broad filler surfaces.

front.note: The suspended wicker egg, tailored cushions and broad circular stand read as one supported assembly.

rear.note: The rear woven cage and braced hanging support remain coherent and distinct.

detail.note: Full-size detail shows the suspension chain, woven ribs and seated cushion piping; the basket weave stays deliberately regular.

underside.note: The cage supports the seat and connects to the visible hanger; the stand bracing remains attached.

clay.note: The clay view confirms the open egg cage, two tailored cushions and continuous stand proportions.

front.note: The rounded ceramic cooker, side shelves and wheeled cradle read clearly as a kamado.

rear.note: The hinge, divided body and timber shelves remain attached to the original cooker form.

detail.note: Thermometer, vent cap, lid band and lower air vent remain distinct under the improved surface response.

underside.note: The closed cooker base is supported by its wheeled frame and the side shelves retain brackets.

clay.note: The clay view preserves the domed lid, banded lower body and clear supporting cart.

front.note: The empty slatted log store has readable side boards and a capped roof.

rear.note: Back slats and uprights create a coherent ventilated storage frame.

detail.note: Timber faces show restrained grain and distinct board edges without exaggerated roughness.

underside.note: The floor slats and roof support meet the uprights; the open front remains intentional.

clay.note: The clay view confirms the roof, open front and ventilated timber construction; logs are not part of this empty store.

front.note: The four-post pergola retains a clean rectangular frame and aligned roof edge.

rear.note: The rear view reveals the closely spaced angled louvers beneath the upper perimeter.

detail.note: Post caps, beam intersections and base plates remain legible with restrained coated-metal finish.

underside.note: The underside clearly shows individual louvers, supporting beams and all four anchored posts.

clay.note: The clay view retains the open pergola structure; roof louvers naturally overlap from the front viewing angle.

front.note: The mushroom reflector, protected burner and tall stem read immediately as a patio heater.

rear.note: The rear view preserves the curved tank housing and distinct upper burner assembly.

detail.note: The fine burner guard and rounded reflector remain clear; strong highlights are consistent with the original metal finish.

underside.note: The underside shows the reflector bowl, burner guard and closed supported base.

clay.note: The clay silhouette retains the narrow pole and broad reflector without new faceting or detached parts.

front.note: Barrel chamber, side hopper, shelf and wheeled cart remain recognizable and well separated.

rear.note: The rear chimney and cooker body retain their original attached construction.

detail.note: Door handle, hopper display and rim bands remain distinct under restrained metal surface detail.

underside.note: The lower shelf, cart legs and cooker supports remain connected and readable.

clay.note: The clay view confirms the barrel, chimney, hopper and supported cart; internal cooking mechanics remain simplified.

front.note: Two timber planter boxes clearly support the intervening slatted bench.

rear.note: The rear view preserves the planter volumes and the centered bench connection.

detail.note: Board grain, rim strips and seat slats read cleanly without changing the original layout.

underside.note: The underside reveals supported seat rails and closed planter bottoms.

clay.note: The clay view confirms separate planter walls and the connected bench span; the soil surfaces remain simple.

front.note: Tank, pump, valve and connecting pipe form a recognizable pool equipment station.

rear.note: The rear motor housing and pressure-vessel proportions remain coherent on the service pad.

detail.note: The gauge, selector body and pump fins stay legible; the rigid pipe elbows remain a simplified fitting representation.

underside.note: The service pad supports both tank and pump and the rigid connection remains attached.

clay.note: The clay view preserves the layered tank, motor and valve construction without implying a complete plumbing installation.

front.note: The A-frame pool ladder has distinct grip rails, paired steps and a top platform.

rear.note: The reverse view retains the matching step flight and splayed supporting legs.

detail.note: Full-size detail shows separate anti-slip step grooves and attached metal rails; bends remain lightly faceted at close range.

underside.note: The underside confirms supported step plates, spreader braces and rubber feet.

clay.note: The clay view keeps the recognizable A-frame ladder silhouette and separate handrails.

front.note: Individual white slats follow the reclined contoured lounger silhouette.

rear.note: The reverse view shows the continuous rise through seat and back with four supported feet.

detail.note: Slat edges and narrow separation remain clear; the restrained white finish avoids coarse fabric treatment.

underside.note: The curved underframe supports the slats and meets the original legs.

clay.note: The clay view preserves a shaped slatted pool lounger rather than a single flat panel.

front.note: Open towel cubbies, slatted shelves and a lower hamper remain recognizable.

rear.note: Rear timber panels and side rails form a coherent storage frame.

detail.note: Timber grain, cubby dividers and the individual hamper battens remain distinct.

underside.note: The underside confirms supported shelves, dividers and four corner uprights.

clay.note: The clay view retains the valet's open cubby layout and lower hamper construction.

front.note: The tall protected glass-column heater retains its tapered cage and vented base.

rear.note: The reverse view preserves the fine protective framework and upper reflector cap.

detail.note: Cage wires, lower vent slots and the small controls remain legible at application scale.

underside.note: The underside shows a closed grounded base and continuous cage-to-cap support.

clay.note: The clay silhouette retains the narrow pyramid heater; the unlit tube does not claim an active flame.

front.note: The rounded corrugated planter wall and recessed soil surface read clearly.

rear.note: The reverse view preserves continuous corrugation and the original shallow rectangular footprint.

detail.note: The rounded rim, repeated metal ribs and small fasteners remain distinct.

underside.note: The underside shows the continuous outer wall and dark contained base without new gaps.

clay.note: The clay view confirms consistent rounded corners and corrugated wall construction; soil detail remains intentionally restrained.

front.note: The striped fabric awning has a clear roller edge and supported extended canopy.

rear.note: The rear view preserves the shallow fabric slope and continuous outer rail.

detail.note: The stripe boundaries and fine fabric grain remain clean across the stretched canopy.

underside.note: The underside reveals the original lateral supporting arms and mounting structure.

clay.note: The clay view preserves the extended awning geometry; no animated retraction is asserted.

front.note: The rope-backed dining armchair retains a tailored seat and timber arm caps.

rear.note: The back weaving and connected metal frame remain readable.

detail.note: Rope intersections, seated cushion piping and warm timber arm surfaces look coherent.

underside.note: The underside shows the woven seat support and attached legs beneath the cushion.

clay.note: The clay view preserves distinct frame, arms, rope back and seat proportions.

front.note: The rounded pale tabletop and vertically fluted drum base read clearly as a low conversation table.

rear.note: The reverse view retains the consistent round top and supporting drum proportions.

detail.note: Restrained stone grain, the eased top rim and narrow base flutes remain clear.

underside.note: The drum meets the underside of the tabletop and retains a closed dark foot.

clay.note: The clay view confirms smooth round profiles and distinct vertical fluting without visible support gaps.

front.note: The recessed steel sink and louvered cabinet doors form a recognizable outdoor sink unit.

rear.note: The rear ventilation and closed cabinet body remain coherent beneath the basin.

detail.note: The basin has visible depth, distinct rim steps and an attached faucet; door slats stay separate.

underside.note: The cabinet underside is closed and supported on small adjustable feet.

clay.note: The clay view retains the actual basin recess, door divisions and faucet silhouette.

front.note: The shower's curved upper body is visibly assembled from angular separated chunks rather than a continuous formed column.

rear.note: Rear body seams remain conspicuous along the rising column and curved crown.

detail.note: Full-size detail shows open bevel gaps between neighboring aluminium sections around the mixer and lower tap.

underside.note: The base and outlets remain attached, but the separated body sections need a continuous measured shell.

clay.note: The clay view confirms the segmented crown and discontinuous body; retain the original nozzle, controls and overall dimensions while correcting that construction.

front.note: Timber cladding, white spa rim, four corner seats and headrests remain recognizable around the water surface.

rear.note: The reverse view preserves the same seat arrangement and fitted side cladding.

detail.note: The water, headrests, rim and timber slats remain distinct; internal jets stay a restrained catalog detail.

underside.note: The closed base and full cladding enclosure remain coherent below the spa rim.

clay.note: The clay view confirms the recessed spa interior and four-seat arrangement with unchanged outer proportions.

front.note: The wheeled steel prep table retains separate worktop, undershelf and push handle.

rear.note: Rear tubular legs and shelf edges remain connected and readable.

detail.note: Rolled edges, utensil hooks and restrained steel reflections give the table clear construction.

underside.note: The underside confirms the folded apron, supported shelves and four casters.

clay.note: The clay view retains the simple open trolley frame and coherent work surfaces.

front.note: The folded steel chair silhouette is recognizable, but the lower braces visibly float away from the sloping frames.

rear.note: The rear lower brace does not meet both supporting frame members at its authored height.

detail.note: Full-size detail exposes an unsupported crossbar end; source brace positions miss the angled leg centerlines and need measured contact correction.

underside.note: The lower foot braces remain detached from the frame even though the seat and hinges are coherent.

clay.note: The clay view retains the folding chair form but reveals the free lower crossbars; preserve the original green material and slat construction when seating them.

front.note: A gently sagging cable carries distinct warm bulbs between the two weighted posts.

rear.note: The reverse view preserves the consistent cable sag and supported post bases.

detail.note: Individual sockets, bulbs and small pole collars remain readable without excessive glow.

underside.note: The underside confirms the closed round ballast bases and attached light string.

clay.note: The clay view retains the thin cable, individual bulbs and stable two-post silhouette.

front.note: The timber double daybed supports one broad tailored mattress and two restrained back cushions.

rear.note: The rear frame and back rail retain coherent support beneath the cushions.

detail.note: Mattress edges, subtle piping and timber rails stay connected with restrained surface grain.

underside.note: The underside shows a continuous slatted platform, supporting frame and four legs.

clay.note: The clay view confirms a connected daybed frame and fitted bedding without unsupported cushion gaps.

front.note: The timber lounge frame and gently tensioned green sling read clearly as an outdoor chair.

rear.note: Rear sling attachment and angled timber supports remain coherent.

detail.note: Fabric grain stays restrained and the arm joints, fasteners and sling edges remain distinct.

underside.note: The underside shows the sling spanning its frame and the connected support rails.

clay.note: The clay view preserves the folded frame and shaped suspended cloth surface.

front.note: The hipped roof, standing seams and timber posts form a clear garden gazebo.

rear.note: The reverse view preserves coherent roof planes, ridge and corner supports.

detail.note: Roof seams meet at the hips and the timber corner braces remain visibly attached.

underside.note: The underside reveals radial roof rafters, beams and supported corner posts.

clay.note: The clay view confirms the framed hip-roof construction with legible roof layers and bracing.

front.note: The timber privacy slats sit above a matching planter within a metal support frame.

rear.note: Rear uprights and feet retain clear support behind the slatted screen.

detail.note: Timber grain, individual slat spacing and the planter rim remain restrained and readable.

underside.note: The underside confirms the planter enclosure and connected supporting feet.

clay.note: The clay view preserves the open slat pattern, planter volume and stable freestanding frame.

front.note: The triangular fabric sail spans three posts with gently curved tension edges.

rear.note: The reverse view retains the same asymmetric post heights and stretched cloth shape.

detail.note: The cloth has subtle grain and curved edges without excessive thickness or faceting.

underside.note: The underside confirms a continuous fabric panel attached at the three posts.

clay.note: The clay view retains the thin curved sail silhouette; detailed tension hardware remains simplified.

front.note: Three timber planter boxes form a clear stepped balcony planter on an angled stand.

rear.note: Rear uprights and cross supports remain attached beneath the tiers.

detail.note: Board grain, rim strips and the recessed soil surfaces stay distinct.

underside.note: The underside shows closed planter bottoms and supporting rails rather than unsupported boxes.

clay.note: The clay view preserves the staggered three-tier construction and original narrow footprint.

front.note: The hollow can and perforated rose are recognizable, but both handles have visibly coarse polygonal corners.

rear.note: The rose is visibly separated from the end of the long spout and requires a connected neck.

detail.note: Full-size detail confirms the angular carrying handle and blocky straight spout; preserve the genuine can cavity and individual rose perforations.

underside.note: The underside retains the closed can base, while the handle and rose connections need improved construction.

clay.note: The clay view confirms coarse handle bends and a detached rose; use bounded rounded handles and a measured spout-to-rose connection.

front.note: The tapered refuse bin retains its hinged dark lid, handle and separate wheels.

rear.note: The rear axle, lid hinge and handles remain coherent and attached.

detail.note: Lid edging, molded vertical ribs and the small original bin label stay readable.

underside.note: The underside shows a closed base with a supported axle and two wheels.

clay.note: The clay view preserves the tapered bin body and distinct lid/wheel construction.

front.note: The woven club chair has a continuous wraparound frame and fitted green cushions.

rear.note: The rear woven shell supports the back cushion and meets the lower frame.

detail.note: Full-size visible weave and restrained cloth grain remain distinct; the seat piping is seated and even.

underside.note: The underside shows a woven seat support, attached legs and the coherent wraparound frame.

clay.note: The clay view preserves the arm/back shell and two tailored cushions without new gaps or floating trim.
